Load a completed run as a vivax_run object

Source: R/load.R
load_run.Rd

Wraps a run's output directory; use load_events(), load_state(), trees_path() and load_params() to access its contents.

Usage

load_run(outdir)

Arguments

outdir

a run output directory, or a vivax_run, whose directory is read again.

Value

a vivax_run object, a list of:

  • outdir, the run directory (character);

  • params, the parameter set, as load_params() gives it;

  • seed, the seed SLiM ran with (integer; a double beyond the 32-bit range, which only a run started with slim directly, with -d SEED, can have);

  • extinct_tick, the tick on which the run went extinct and ended, or NA (integer);

  • never_started, TRUE for a run that never started (logical);

  • slim_version and malariafwd_version (character; malariafwd_version is "unknown" for a run started with slim directly);

  • genome_length, the simulated genome in bp, and n_chromosomes (integers), and recomb_within, the crossover rate within a chromosome per bp per meiosis (double);

  • complete, TRUE when the directory holds the whole run its DONE file describes (logical).

A field the run's params.tsv does not record is NA.

Details

A run goes extinct on the first tick on which no parasite is left in any host or mosquito, hypnozoites included, and no importation is still to come. It ends on that tick: its events.tsv and state.tsv stop there, and its params.tsv ends with the tick as an EXTINCT_TICK row, also when the tick is the run's last day.

A founder-free run whose imports all fail to establish a parasite never starts, whether by chance or because its settings let no import take (P_PRIMARY = 0 with a hypnozoite batch mean of 0, or an IMPORT_RATE_PER_TICK window whose rate is 0 throughout, as under IMPORT_RATE_BOOST = 0 from a trigger before the window). It ends on the first tick after its last import day, but not before tick 10, or on its last day if that comes first, and its params.tsv ends with a NEVER_STARTED row. It holds no parasite: its tree sequence has no nodes and its events are at most imports that did not take. Every function that reads a run takes such a run: its tables have their usual columns and no rows, its counts are 0, and a quantity that needs a parasite is NA (arg_summary() reports no samples).

The functions that summarise a window of a run take its length from SIM_DAYS, so the days after an extinction count as days with no parasite.

A directory without params.tsv or events.tsv is not a run and is refused. One whose DONE file is missing, or whose files have changed since the run finished (see run_sim()), loads with complete = FALSE and a warning of class malariafwd_incomplete_run, given once per directory per session by every function that reads the directory. A run started with slim directly has no DONE. suppressWarnings(..., classes = "malariafwd_incomplete_run") silences it.

Examples

run <- load_run(example_run()$outdir)   # a run directory, read again
run$seed
#> [1] 2
run$params$N_HOSTS
#> [1] 60
